This is based on the project docs only. I didn't open any source files, so line numbers come from the docs' anchors and may have drifted. Nothing was modified.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` (near `ShopTransactionBody:159`) | Add `RestBody { sessionId: string; characterId: number }`. Add a cost constant, e.g. `INN_REST_COST` (flat), or a per-level formula such as `level * N`. The Worker owns this value. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (**new**) | `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with `POST /`. Steps: validate the body (400), then `getCharacter` (404). Load the session with `loadSession`, falling back to `rebuildSession` if KV has expired. Return 400 with `inCombat: true` if `session.inCombat`, as `routes/action.ts` does. Return 400 if `hp >= max_hp` (nothing to restore) or `gold < cost` (insufficient gold). Then call `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })`, which is on the whitelist. Optionally append a history turn and call `saveSession`, then insert an `adventure_log` row. Respond with `{ narrative, updatedCharacter, cost }`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts` (route mounts, about lines 41-48) | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. CORS needs no change. |

`services/character.ts` needs no change, since `updateCharacter` already handles `hp` and `gold`. Only extract a service function if more than one route will share the logic. No schema change or migration is needed, because `hp`, `max_hp` and `gold` already exist on `characters`.

An optional `askDM` call would only narrate the stay. HP and gold must be computed in the route.

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` (near `ActionResponse:95`) | Add a `RestResponse { narrative: string; updatedCharacter: Character; cost: number }`. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` (after `levelUp():74`) | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which posts to `${API_BASE}/api/rest` and returns `Observable<RestResponse>`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `rest()` handler (near `levelUp():183`). It calls `api.rest`, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)`, and pushes a narrative or system entry. It also updates the campaign slot via `auth.updateCampaign`, like `levelUp` does. Errors are read from `err.error.error`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn (N gold)" button in the left column beside Inventory. Disable it when `inCombat()`, when HP is full, or when gold is below the cost. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Style the button if needed. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy: success updates the character, an error shows a message, and the button is disabled in combat. |

`character-state.service.ts` needs no change, because `setCharacter` already refreshes the sheet and HP bar. The `hpPercent` computed value updates on its own.

## Things to watch
- **Combat:** block rest while `inCombat`, otherwise the player could heal for free mid-fight. Check that the session flag is the source of truth.
- **Death (B-10):** a character at 0 HP can still act. Decide whether resting is allowed at 0 HP. It's probably fine and even useful.
- **Potions (B-05):** potion healing is browser-only and never saved, so the Worker's HP can be stale relative to the UI. Rest sets HP from the server, which would overwrite that.
- **Where it's offered:** do you want rest available anywhere, or only at an inn location? Gating on location would need the session's location, which only the AI sets via `locationChange`. That's fragile, so I'd recommend allowing it anywhere outside combat.
